summary: Verified two items end-to-end via public URL. (1) BUG FIX: Super Admin panel now loads /admin (dashboard), /admin/clinicas, /admin/usuarios with ZERO HTTP 500 responses in Network (previously multiple AttributeError 500s from .maybe_single().execute() returning None). Console shows only expected 403s from clinic-scoped endpoints, matching agent-to-agent context. (2) NOTIFICATION IN-APP: Complete flow works. Clinic admin (prueba3@gmail.com) creates ticket TEST_NOTIF_1790221826 -> pre-existing badge=0 as expected. Super Admin (info@cortexiagt.com) opens the ticket in /admin/soporte and replies via admin-send-reply-btn -> success toast 'Respuesta enviada'. Clinic admin re-login: sidebar shows [data-testid=support-unread-badge] with text '1'. /dashboard/soporte shows ticket-unread-dot-6c2450f3-...-e61fbaaf12cd (unique) plus 'Nueva respuesta' label and highlighted card. After opening the ticket and reloading, badge count=0 and unread dot count=0. Feature and bug fix both PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Send button for admin replies has no visible text (icon-only). Consider adding aria-label 'Enviar respuesta' for a11y — data-testid admin-send-reply-btn is present, but screen-reader users would benefit from an accessible name.
